description: The configuration the ACT binds to a source when its DataType is AGGREGATE_DATA. It controls the minimum number of matching rows required before an aggregate result is returned and how facet counts are post-processed.

suppressionThreshold.description: The minimum number of matching rows required before an aggregate result is returned. An aggregate query that matches a non-zero row count below this threshold is suppressed. Must be a positive value. This is also the k value enforced by cell-level k-anonymity: a participant-count cell whose value is non-zero but below this threshold is suppressed.

quasiIdentifierColumnNames.description: The names of the columns of the source that are quasi-identifiers (QIDs), including any direct participant identifier. Optional: when omitted, the source is restricted to aggregate-only reads (no row-level data is ever returned, and the total count is gated against the suppression threshold). When provided, the source additionally allows row-returning aggregate queries with cell-level k-anonymity applied. Each name must match an actual column name of the source; at query time, if any configured QID name does not match a column of the source, an exception is thrown. A QID column may only appear in a query as the argument of a COUNT (or COUNT DISTINCT) or in a WHERE clause. Any other use (bare projection, a non-count aggregate, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, SELECT DISTINCT, or an arithmetic/string expression) is permitted only for the aggregate-only response (the gated total count and obscured facet statistics); a query that both uses a QID in one of those ways and requests row results is rejected with an error identifying the offending use.

countSuppressionStrategy.description: Selects how a query that returns rows treats a participant-count cell whose value is non-zero but below the suppression threshold. Applies only when quasi-identifier columns are configured and a query requests row results. Optional; when not set, below-threshold rows are excluded (equivalent to EXCLUDE_ROW).

facetPostProcessingConfig.description: Configuration describing how facet counts are post-processed. Optional.
